FAQ

Before you come.

Answers to a few common questions.

Do I need to know anyone?

No. Come on your own. For Boulder Culture-hosted gatherings, we’ll post a meeting point. For events hosted by someone else, check their listing.

Is it free?

Boulder Culture-hosted gatherings will be free. Other organizers set their own prices, so check the event listing. Food and drinks are separate.

Is this a club or part of CU?

Neither. There’s no membership, and Boulder Culture is independent of CU Boulder.

When’s the first one?

The date and location aren’t confirmed yet. Email Leo if you’d like to hear when they are.

Can I help?

Yes. Offer a space, suggest an event, or help lead a gathering. The foundation is still forming, is not yet a 501(c)(3), and isn’t taking donations on this site.
